message.body: Today, we celebrate the unfailing love of Jesus Christ, who offered His life on the cross so that we might be reconciled to God. Salvation is not a reward we earn through our own efforts, but a free and miraculous gift received simply through faith in Him. When we confess Jesus as our Lord and Savior, our past is forgiven, our hearts are made new, and our eternal future is forever secured. Step into His open arms today, knowing that no matter where you have been, His grace is more than enough to redeem and restore your life.
message.title: Found in His Grace: The Gift of Salvation

scriptures.title: The Lord at My Right Hand
scriptures.verse: I have set the LORD always before me; for he is at my right hand, so I shall not slip.
scriptures.note: Life anchored in God cannot be shaken, because the One who holds us also holds our steps.

scriptures.title: The Confidence of Faith
scriptures.verse: Now faith is being sure of what we hope for and being certain of what we do not see.
scriptures.note: Faith lets us walk with God into seasons we cannot yet explain.

scriptures.title: Hope In Jesus
scriptures.verse: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope.
scriptures.note: Every promise we hold rests on the faithfulness of Christ Himself.
